message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is acquired from a local camera (cv2.VideoCapture) and local filesystem; no remote source fetching with checksum or authentication is present.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only filters files by extension regex and performs face detection; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: VGG16 pretrained weights are loaded via Keras without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads images and uses LabelEncoder/OneHotEncoder but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/SGD optimizer with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial attack/stress test logic is present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (recognition) accepts image/video input without any visible shape, range, or schema validation before passing frames to the model; file type filtering in train.py applies only during training, not inference.

No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output probabilities for NaN, out-of-range values, or applies calibrated confidence thresholds before returning recognition results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based facial recognition system, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
